_comment: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE ONLY — obviously-fake database names throughout. The real db-triage.json carries private instance data (real Postgres database names on the owner's own instance) and is gitignored, never committed. This file documents the required SHAPE migrate-04-absorb-pipeline-tables.js's loadDbTriage()/classifyDb() implement, and is also what test/migrations/test-migrate-04-absorb-pipeline-tables.js loads (via --db-triage) so the suite runs green with no private data present, in CI or anywhere else. E-1/E-8 (CONSOLIDATION-RUNBOOK.md §6.1(e) amendment, memory-manager#11(e)): TOTAL classification over every non-template pg_database entry — a flat map of db name -> one of four classes. classifyDb()'s DEFAULT branch (a db name absent from this map) is 'UNCLASSIFIED', a loud, run-blocking refusal — never a silent skip and never a silent REAL-MIGRATE guess. cm#189: this same file also feeds migrate-03-corpus-project-id.js's total provenance classification (loadDbTriageFull()/classifyDbProvenance(), scripts/migrations/migrate-04-absorb-pipeline-tables.js) via the added `test_artifact_db_patterns` key below — one file, two loaders, backward-compatible (loadDbTriage() ignores keys it doesn't read).

classes._comment: The four real classes. REAL-MIGRATE: this script connects and migrates in-scope tables from it (an empty result for a REAL-MIGRATE db with zero in-scope tables is a normal, reported outcome, never an error). EPHEMERAL-DROP: loud-skipped, self-evidently disposable test/debug scratch data, mirrors CONSOLIDATION-RUNBOOK.md §16.3's own triage table. OWNER-REVIEW: loud-skipped, V6 'leave alone' — never migrated, never dropped, without explicit owner sign-off. ENGINE-INFRA: loud-skipped; this repo's OWN target/test-fixture databases (memory_manager_staging, claude_memory_eval_test, the Postgres maintenance db, etc.) — distinguished from EPHEMERAL-DROP only for clearer reporting: permanent infra this script structurally must never touch as a SOURCE, not disposable test debris a human might someday delete.

_comment_test_artifact_db_patterns: cm#189 (spec-adversary A-1/A-5) -- REQUIRED key below (may be an empty array, never absent). Every entry MUST be a plain pattern string, anchored with a leading '^' (an unanchored pattern can match a substring of a real database name), and MUST NOT match any name this file triages REAL-MIGRATE or OWNER-REVIEW (checked at load time, loadDbTriageFull() FATALs on a violation) -- never a comment/annotation entry inside the array itself, since every array entry IS a live pattern. This is an OVERLAY on top of the `databases` explicit map, never the totality mechanism -- an unmatched, untriaged name is still UNCLASSIFIED, a loud refusal (A-1). These patterns are evidence-derived from this repo's own test/scripts/test-* fixture-DB minting sites (see the authoring PR body for the verified minting-site cross-check); a fixture suite that mints a NEW naming convention adds its own pattern here, or the operator adds an explicit EPHEMERAL-DROP entry to `databases` above -- never widen an existing pattern to cover an unrelated convention.
